title: Move the Dock to another edge of the screen in System Settings

setup.why: Keep the Mac's own value for teardown, then put the Dock on an edge that is not the asked one and restart it so it shows.

instruction: Using System Settings, put the Dock {{pos.say}} of the screen.

checks.why: com.apple.dock orientation, which "Position on screen" in System Settings › Desktop & Dock writes, is the asked edge (no key reads as bottom, the default).
argv: defaults read com.apple.dock orientation 2>/dev/null || echo bottom
if application id "com.apple.systempreferences" is running then

teardown.why: Put back the Mac's own value and restart the Dock.

oracle.why: Write the asked edge and restart the Dock, as the setting does.

argv: defaults write com.apple.dock orientation -string {{pos.want}} && killall Dock
